mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company WHERE account_id = #{accountId}) AS company_registered, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM saved_support_program WHERE account_id = #{accountId}) AS program_saved, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account_notification_setting WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deadline_reminder_enabled = TRUE ) AS deadline_reminder_enabled, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_report WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND status = 'READY') AS daily_report_ready, ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM application_preparation WHERE owner_account_id = #{accountId} AND demo_seed_key IS NULL ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM combination_review WHERE owner_account_id = #{accountId} AND demo_seed_key IS NULL ) ) AS preparation_started, (SELECT closed_at FROM account_getting_started WHERE account_id = #{accountId}) AS closed_at, (SELECT completed_at FROM account_getting_started WHERE account_id = #{accountId}) AS completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_getting_started (account_id, closed_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, NULL, #{now}, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at = IF(completed_at IS NULL, #{now}, updated_at), completed_at = COALESCE(completed_at, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT completed_at FROM account_getting_started WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_getting_started (account_id, closed_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, CASE WHEN #{closed} THEN #{now} ELSE NULL END, NULL, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE closed_at = CASE WHEN #{closed} THEN COALESCE(closed_at, #{now}) ELSE NULL END, updated_at = #{now}
